source.shim: block/enum declarations, FP16 conversion, assertion macros, OpenMP initialization; extracted function bodies and codebook tables unchanged

protocol.layout: packed geometry rows per chart; projection rows per output; zero-pad each row to a multiple of 256, then discard padding after dequantization
protocol.execution: actual packed IQ2_XXS roundtrip then FP32 PyTorch arithmetic; no native low-bit runtime, INT8 activation quantization or retraining
protocol.retained_fp32: all activations, geometry damping/warp parameters, attention, embeddings and vocabulary head
protocol.calibration: none; required importance vector set to ones, including padding
protocol.verification: independent NumPy decoder matches C dequantization bitwise for every quantized tensor
